ta_thanh_thuoc.wants: The hundredth feather for her fan, and her son home to see the socket filled.
ta_thanh_thuoc.secret: In the dark of each moon she sells her duplicate feathers by kind to the fan-maker Hàng Thải Vũ, to pay a stone-cutter for a marker for Ổ Tùng Lâm, whom the apes never gave back.

giai_van_tieu.wants: A post-house of his own in Hà Loan with a roof of birds, and every seal on the road one he can read.
giai_van_tieu.secret: He opens the second-sealed letters, copies the seal into a wax tablet, and closes them again with a spoon-heated knife; Chử Trì Âm has not yet noticed the replies arriving a day late.
giai_van_tieu.add: Since the head told him to forget it, he has begun to open and reseal them.

hang_thai_vu.add: She returns a whole bundle for one crooked rib and passes the next unseen.
hang_thai_vu.app: Rows of old burn blisters along both forearms, one per inner-gate season.

tran_da_minh.add: He sleeps in the shade while his lime-sticks dry.

nhieu_tieu_yen.app: Grub-juice stains on her sleeves and a whistle's red dent in her lower lip.

que_hoang_oanh.add: When the stall's post bird died in her hand she sang on, and fetched another the next day.
que_hoang_oanh.app: A cinnamon-picker's cracked brown palms and a voice louder than her body.

phong_tieu_cuu.add: He reads over his master's shoulder and sells the gist of the letters at the Hà Loan well.
phong_tieu_cuu.app: A rider's squint and a left ear sunburnt permanently pink.

hoan_truc_lung.app: Split-cane cuts across every finger and a raft-village sway on dry land.

phu_vu_to.app: An ink-stained thumb from marking the feather rolls.

lam_the_ngo.app: Hands steady as a perch, and one eye clouded white.

kieu_thuy_nhi.app: Fine peck-scars on her hands, and birds that sit on her head unasked.

ma_tin_phi.add: He has learned to look away from the second seal for the price of a meal.
ma_tin_phi.app: A paunch he blames on the road, and a horn he blows at no one.

ky_hong_phien.app: Singed fingertips and a grey streak where a spark took her fringe.

o_tieu_sao.app: Grub-meal flecks on his sleeves and a boy's too-wide grin.

khau_tinh_minh.app: Ink to the second knuckle and a notebook cord around her neck.
